Rashi on Berakhot 18b:10:1.english: Apparently they know - Things that are spoken among the living.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:1.english: To the courtyard of death - To the cemetery.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:2.english: In the hinge of the door - In the hole of the threshold of the house, in which the door turns.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:4.hebrew: גובתא - קנה. ובשביל שמתה ילדה, אמרה כן לעגמת נפש:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:4.english: A tube - A reed [tube]. And because she died young, she said this to evoke sorrow.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:5.english: With so-and-so who is coming tomorrow - [She is coming] for burial.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:6.hebrew: אלמא ידעי - מה שעושין, שידעה זו שזו גוססת ונטויה למות:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:12:6.english: Evidently they know - What [the living] do, as this [deceased woman] knew that this [other woman] was moribund and about to die.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:13:1.hebrew: דלמא דומה - מלאך שהוא ממונה על המתים קדים ומכריז להו: ״עכשיו יבא פלוני״, אבל שאר דברי החיים אינם יודעים:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:13:1.english: Perhaps Dumah - [Dumah is] an angel who is appointed over the dead; he comes beforehand and announces to them: "Now So-and-so will arrive," but the rest of the affairs of the living they do not know.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:1.hebrew: בעינא אבא - מבקש אני את אבא, כך היה שמו:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:1.english: I want Abba - I am seeking Abba; that was his name.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:2.hebrew: א"ל - המתים נגלו לו כאילו הם חוץ מקבריהם ויושבים בעגולה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:2.english: They said to him - The dead appeared to him as if they were outside their graves and sitting in a circle.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:3.hebrew: חזייה - שמואל ללוי חברו, שהיה יושב חוץ לישיבה של שאר מתים:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:3.english: He saw him - Shmuel [saw] his colleague Levi, who was sitting outside the assembly of the rest of the deceased.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:14:4.english: All those years - The number of years that you did not enter the academy of Rabbi Afes, [as related] in Tractate Ketubot, in the chapter "Hanoseh Et HaIsha" (Ketubot 103b).

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:15:1.hebrew: חזייה - שמואל לאבוה, דקא בכי וחייך:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:15:1.english: He saw him - Shmuel [saw] his father, who was crying and laughing.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:15:2.english: That you are coming soon - You will soon be buried.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:16:1.hebrew: באמתא דרחיא - כל בנין מושב הרחים קרוי אמת הרחיים:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:16:1.english: In the mill-casing - The entire structure of the base of the mill is called the mill-casing.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:16:2.hebrew: אלמא ידעי - מי חשוב בין החיים:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:16:2.english: Apparently they know - Who is important among the living.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:17:1.english: This is the land - It is written in [the passage concerning] the death of Moses.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:2:1.hebrew: גזיזי דברדא - חתיכות של ברד, והקרח שקורין גלאנצ"א בלע"ז — והיינו ביום השלג:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:2:1.english: Blocks of hail - Pieces of hail, and the ice that is called glace in Old French — and that is [what is meant by] "on the snowy day."

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:2:2.hebrew: ונחת וטבל לקריו - כדי לעסוק בתורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:2:2.english: And he descended and immersed for his seminal emission - In order to engage in Torah study.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:2:3.hebrew: דתנא סיפרא דבי רב - תורת כהנים:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:2:3.english: That he learned the Sifra of the School of Rav - [This is] Torat Kohanim.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:3:1.hebrew: חלל רשע - על צדקיהו הוא אומר, ועדיין בימי יחזקאל חי היה, וקורהו חלל:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:3:1.english: Slain, wicked [one] - It is concerning Zedekiah that [the verse] says [this]; and in the days of Ezekiel he was still alive, yet it calls him "slain".

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:4:1.english: To the villages - To engage in the work of their estate.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:4:2.hebrew: אייקר תלמודייהו - אשתכח תלמודם מגרסתם. אייקר — הוכבד עליהם מחמת שכחה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:4:2.english: Their learning became heavy - Their learning was forgotten from their recitation. *Iyyakar* — it became heavy upon them due to forgetfulness.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:6:1.hebrew: צערא דידהו - צער גופם ממש, כגון עקיצת הרימה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:6:1.english: Their own pain - The actual pain of their body, such as the bite of worms.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:1.english: Two spirits - Of two deceased girls.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:2.hebrew: ונשמע - ונדע מה גזרו היום פורענות בעולם, שהעולם נדון בר"ה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:2.english: And let us hear - And we will know what calamity was decreed today upon the world, for the world is judged on Rosh HaShanah.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:3.hebrew: הפרגוד - מחיצה המבדלת בין מקום השכינה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:3.english: The curtain [pargod] - A partition that separates the place of the Divine Presence.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:4.hebrew: ברביעה ראשונה - יורה. שלש רביעיות הן: בכירה, שניה ושלישית. ראשונה בי"ז במרחשון, שניה בכ"ג, שלישית בר"ח כסליו:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:4.english: During the first rainfall - The early rain [yoreh]. There are three rainfalls: the early [one], the second, and the third. The first is on the seventeenth of Marcheshvan, the second on the twenty-third, and the third on the New Moon of Kislev.

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:5.hebrew: ברד מלקה אותו - שעתיד ברד ליפול סמוך לרביעה ראשונה, ומה שנזרע כבר הוקשה והברד שוברו, והנזרע בשניה עדיין רך הוא ואינו נשבר בשביל הברד, כענין שנאמר: ״והפשתה והשעורה נכתה, והחטה והכוסמת לא נכו״ (שמות ט׳:ל״ב):
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:7:5.english: Hail strikes it - For hail was destined to fall close to the first rainfall, and that which was sown [then] had already hardened and the hail breaks it; whereas that which was sown in the second [rainfall] is still tender and is not broken on account of the hail, similar to that which is stated: "And the flax and the barley were smitten, and the wheat and the spelt were not smitten" (Exodus 9:31–32).

Rashi on Berakhot 18b:8:1.hebrew: שדפון - מלקה הרך, ואינו משדף הקשה:
Rashi on Berakhot 18b:8:1.english: Blight - [It] strikes the tender [crop], but does not blight the hardened [crop].

Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:16:1.hebrew: אלמא ידעי - מדקאמר "לעגל קא אתית", ולא מצי לשנויי כדלעיל: "דומה קדים ואמר להו" — דהיינו דוקא לאלתר, אבל כל כך לא היה מקדים, דהוא עצמו אינו יודע:
Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:16:1.english: "Apparently they know" - [The Gemara infers this] from the fact that [Shmuel's father] said, "You are coming soon." And [the Gemara] could not answer as above, [that] "Dumah precedes and tells them," for that applies specifically immediately [beforehand]; but he would not precede [to tell them] so far in advance, for [Dumah] himself does not know [so far ahead].

Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:1:1.hebrew: בן איש חי אטו כולי עלמא - בספרים מדויקים כתיב "חי" וקרינן "חיל", ומן הכתיב דייק הכי — שלא כתיב "חיל" אלא "חי":
Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:1:1.english: "The son of a living man: Is that to say everyone..." - In accurate texts, it is written ḥai [living] and we read [it as] ḥayil [valiant], and from the written text [the Gemara] deduces this — for it is not written ḥayil, but rather ḥai.

Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:2:1.english: "In the midst of the pit" - For it [the book of Leviticus] is in the middle of the books [of the Torah].

Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:2:2.hebrew: סיפרא דבי רב - מהארי דריש, שהוא חמור שבספרים:
Tosafot on Berakhot 18b:2:2.english: "Sifra of the school of Rav" - [The Gemara] expounds [this] from "the lion," for it is the most formidable of the books [of the Torah].
